_doc: Tree-based deep-matchmaking questionnaire (revamp). A flat array of nodes; `branch` routes them: `all` is the global core every intent sees, and `casual` / `long_term` / `nikah` are the intent-specific deep layers. `question_tree.nodes_for_intent(intent)` returns the global core plus one branch. The `nikah` branch is complete but never routed to yet (parked). Source: docs research schema (Aimma Deep Matchmaking Data Model). Loaded by question_tree.py and completeness.py; nothing here is hardcoded inline. `ayma_prompt` is a hint for how Ayma raises the topic naturally in conversation, never a scripted question.

nodes.label: First name
nodes.ayma_prompt: what they'd like to be called

nodes.label: Age
nodes.ayma_prompt: their age or date of birth — drives age-distance modelling

nodes.label: Gender identity
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they identify

nodes.label: Interested in
nodes.ayma_prompt: which gender(s) they want to be matched with

nodes.label: Where they live
nodes.ayma_prompt: their city and country now

nodes.label: Relocation / travel radius
nodes.ayma_prompt: how far they'd move or regularly travel for the right person

nodes.label: Ethnic & cultural origin
nodes.ayma_prompt: their ethnic and cultural roots — one or several

nodes.label: Attachment style
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they typically bond and handle closeness under stress

nodes.label: Social energy
nodes.ayma_prompt: how much social time energises vs drains them

nodes.label: How they process decisions
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they work through a hard call

nodes.label: Communication in friction
nodes.ayma_prompt: what they need from a partner mid-disagreement

nodes.label: Daily rhythm
nodes.ayma_prompt: when they're naturally at their best in the day

nodes.label: Domestic order
nodes.ayma_prompt: how tidy they keep a shared space

nodes.label: Alcohol
nodes.ayma_prompt: their relationship with drinking

nodes.label: Smoking / vaping
nodes.ayma_prompt: whether they smoke or vape at all

nodes.label: Cannabis / other substances
nodes.ayma_prompt: cannabis or other recreational substance use

nodes.label: Pets
nodes.ayma_prompt: any animals they live with

nodes.label: Animal allergies / aversions
nodes.ayma_prompt: severe animal allergies or strong aversions

nodes.label: Relationship intent
nodes.ayma_prompt: what kind of relationship they're actually here for — this routes the rest of the questionnaire, so find it out early

nodes.label: Family of origin
nodes.ayma_prompt: who's in their family — parents, siblings, and what that household was like growing up, in their own words

nodes.label: Relationship with parents
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they'd describe their relationship with their parents today — close, distant, complicated, whatever's actually true for them, at whatever level of detail feels comfortable

nodes.label: Relationship with siblings
nodes.ayma_prompt: their relationship with any siblings — closeness or distance, and names if it comes up naturally in conversation, not asked for directly

nodes.label: A formative memory
nodes.ayma_prompt: a memory or moment from growing up that shaped who they are now — something good or meaningful is just as welcome as anything hard

nodes.label: Anything difficult growing up
nodes.ayma_prompt: gently, and only if they seem open to it: whether anything difficult happened growing up that still shapes how they show up in relationships today. Never phrase this like an interview question, never press for detail, and drop it immediately and warmly if they'd rather not go there.

nodes.label: Closest friendships
nodes.ayma_prompt: who their closest friends are — names if it comes up naturally, how they know them, and what makes those friendships matter to them

nodes.label: What kind of friend they are
nodes.ayma_prompt: what kind of friend they are, and how big a role friendships play in their day-to-day life

nodes.label: A past relationship that mattered
nodes.ayma_prompt: about a past relationship that mattered to them — what happened, and what they took from it, at whatever level of detail feels comfortable

nodes.label: Patterns across past relationships
nodes.ayma_prompt: any pattern they've noticed repeating across past relationships, and what, if anything, they're doing differently this time

nodes.label: Love languages (ranked)
nodes.ayma_prompt: which love languages land most for them, ideally in order

nodes.label: Physical activity level
nodes.ayma_prompt: how active a lifestyle they keep and want shared

nodes.label: Spontaneity

scale.max_label: Drop everything and go to the airport right now

nodes.ayma_prompt: how spontaneous vs planned they like plans to be

nodes.label: Communication density
nodes.ayma_prompt: how much day-to-day contact feels right to them

nodes.label: Exclusivity expectations
options: Exclusively seeing one person at a time during casual phases
Multi-dating completely acceptable until explicit consensus
nodes.ayma_prompt: their default expectation about exclusivity while things are casual

nodes.label: Splitting the bill
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they like to handle the cost of outings

nodes.label: Perfect unstructured night
nodes.ayma_prompt: Describe the absolute perfect, unstructured Saturday night encounter you want to experience with a new match. Don't censor details; focus on the vibe, environment, and sensory memories.

nodes.label: A hill they'll die on
nodes.ayma_prompt: What is a highly niche topic, weird hobby, or controversial pop-culture hill that you are prepared to die on?

nodes.label: Saving vs spending on experience

scale.min_label: Frugal, heavy retirement optimisation, asset investing
scale.max_label: Live for the present, high luxury travel, lifestyle-first

nodes.ayma_prompt: where they sit between accumulating capital and spending on experiences

nodes.label: Role of work in life
nodes.ayma_prompt: how central career ambition is to their life plan

nodes.label: Money as a couple
options: Total separate accounts with shared expenses ledger
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they'd want finances structured with a partner

nodes.label: How financial security feels to them
nodes.ayma_prompt: how financially secure they feel day to day, and what money means to them right now — comfort, stress, ambition, whatever's true. Frame it around life-stage and compatibility, never as a bald 'how much do you make' question.

nodes.label: General income comfort
nodes.ayma_prompt: a general sense of how comfortable their financial situation is right now — not an exact number, and entirely fine to skip

nodes.label: Long-term savings outlook
options: Some savings, no real plan yet
nodes.ayma_prompt: how deliberately they're planning for the long term financially — this is about life-stage and mindset, not a balance

nodes.label: Money stress or debt
nodes.ayma_prompt: gently, and only if they seem open to it: whether debt or money worries weigh on them right now, and how they'd want a partner to show up around that. Never pried into, dropped warmly if they'd rather not.

nodes.label: Kids & timeline
nodes.ayma_prompt: whether they want children and roughly when

nodes.label: Extended-family involvement

scale.min_label: Complete independence, rare holiday visits, tight boundaries
scale.max_label: Intergenerational cohabitation, high daily involvement from parents/siblings

nodes.ayma_prompt: how much extended family they want woven into daily life

nodes.label: Parenting approach
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they'd want to raise children, if kids are on the table

nodes.label: Debate vs harmony
options: I need high-frequency, passionate intellectual debates and disagreements to stay engaged
I value harmony, peace, and consensus above intellectual sparring
nodes.ayma_prompt: whether they want intellectual sparring or calm consensus with a partner

nodes.label: Core life anchor
nodes.ayma_prompt: the thing that gives their life its centre of gravity

nodes.label: Facing a crisis together
nodes.ayma_prompt: Imagine a severe external crisis hits your family structure 10 years from now (financial loss, unexpected move). Describe how you and your ideal partner tackle the crisis together behind closed doors.

nodes.label: The self they're leaving behind
nodes.ayma_prompt: What is a version of yourself that you are actively trying to leave behind, and how does your ideal future partner help support that transformation?

nodes.label: Sect / school of thought
nodes.ayma_prompt: their branch or orientation within Islam

nodes.label: Madhhab adherence
nodes.ayma_prompt: how closely they follow a specific school of jurisprudence

nodes.label: Daily prayer (Salah)
options: Consistently prays all 5 daily prayers on time
Prays regularly but sometimes catches up
Actively working towards establishing regular prayers
nodes.ayma_prompt: their daily prayer practice

nodes.label: Halal diet
options: Halal friendly / avoids pork and alcohol
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they keep halal day to day

nodes.label: Riba-free finances
nodes.ayma_prompt: whether they require fully Shariah-compliant, interest-free finances

nodes.label: Modesty — for themselves
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they observe modesty in dress themselves

nodes.label: Modesty — expected of a partner
nodes.ayma_prompt: what they expect from a partner on modest dress

nodes.label: Free-mixing boundary
options: Avoids non-essential mixing with the opposite gender completely
Comfortable in casual / co-ed social gatherings
nodes.ayma_prompt: their comfort with mixed-gender socialising

nodes.label: Wali involvement
options: Wali is involved from Day 1 of matching and screens communication
Wali is introduced once personal compatibility is confirmed
Independent decision-making prior to marriage setup
nodes.ayma_prompt: how they want a wali / guardian involved in the process

nodes.label: Mahr philosophy
options: Standard cultural / financial asset protection baseline
Deferred Mahr structure focused on future security
nodes.ayma_prompt: their view on mahr

nodes.label: Polygyny stance
options: Intentionally looking for a polygynous arrangement
Strictly monogamous marriage contract clause required
nodes.ayma_prompt: their stance on polygyny

nodes.label: Spiritual & worldly balance
nodes.ayma_prompt: Detail how you envision balancing Islamic spiritual goals (Hajj, Umrah, continuous learning, teaching children) with your worldly career and personal ambitions.

nodes.label: Household roles & responsibilities
nodes.ayma_prompt: How do you define the roles and structural rights/responsibilities of a husband and a wife when managing a household? Be specific regarding financial maintenance, emotional labor, and leadership.
